subject: gk
question:
Which of the following statements are correct about the PM MITRA Scheme?

1. It aims to establish integrated large-scale textile parks.

2. It is implemented by the Ministry of Textiles.

3. The scheme promotes synergy among textile value chain segments.
solution:
The correct answer is __**All 1, 2 and 3 are correct**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The PM Mega Integrated Textile Region and Apparel (PM MITRA) scheme aims to establish **integrated large-scale textile parks** to strengthen India’s textile sector.
 
• The scheme is implemented by the **Ministry of Textiles** under the Government of India.
 
• It focuses on promoting **synergy among textile value chain segments**, including spinning, weaving, dyeing, and garment manufacturing.
 
• The scheme is designed to enhance the global competitiveness of the Indian textile industry by creating **world-class infrastructure**.
 
• Under the PM MITRA scheme, **seven textile parks** will be established across India over a period of five years.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Scheme Objectives:** The PM MITRA scheme seeks to boost employment, attract investments, and drive innovation in the textile sector.
 
• **Funding Mechanism:** The scheme provides support for infrastructure development with a **budgetary allocation of ₹4,445 crores**.
 
• **Greenfield and Brownfield Sites:** Both new (greenfield) and existing (brownfield) industrial sites are eligible for development under the scheme.
 
• **Public-Private Partnership:** The scheme encourages participation from the private sector to ensure financial and operational sustainability.
 
• **Significance:** The initiative aligns with the "Make in India" vision, aiming to establish India as a **global textile manufacturing hub**.
